## Context / Problem

Current-base archaeology shows that `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py` (the
`factories` map, ~lines 413-418) registers `review-code`, `review-plan`,
and `sign-review`, but there is no bare `review` command anywhere in the
registry. Two operational-guidance pages still misstate the current CLI
contract:

- `AGENTS.md` (~lines 239-241) claims "the old single-pass `review` verb
  is deprecated and now forwards to `review-plan`" -- there is no such
  forwarding; the verb is gone, not deprecated-and-forwarding.
- `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` (line 3) claims the CLI forms are
  "`rebar review-plan`, `verify-completion`, `review`, `review-code`, and
  `scan-spec`, with `review` retained as an alias" -- no such alias exists.

`docs/exit-codes.md` does NOT contain a stale bare-`review` row: line 184
is the unrelated `identity` command row, and the file's full `review`
table rows (192-199, 259-280) are all live (`review-code`, `review-plan`,
`sign-review`, and the `--review` flag on `edit`/`claim`) -- there is no
bare-`review` row to remove there. `docs/exit-codes.md` needs no edit for
this ticket; it already has no stale bare-`review` claim.

Historical records also mention the removed command and must remain
historical evidence, not be rewritten:
`docs/adr/0005-snapshot-cache-architecture.md:170` records a prior
CLI/MCP mapping; `docs/release-notes.md:441` and
`docs/output-schemas.md:263` expressly describe the surface as removed.

## Approach

Rewrite the stale `AGENTS.md` LLM-operations guidance and the stale
`docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` CLI-form list to describe only live
commands: `review-plan`, `review-code`, `sign-review` where applicable,
`verify-completion`, and `scan-spec`. Do not touch `docs/exit-codes.md`
(it already carries no stale bare-`review` claim -- confirmed above). Do
not alter the ADR or removal-history records. Do not add a
command-reference generator and do not change the CLI registry: source
inspection is the verification boundary, not an implementation target.

## Scope

- `AGENTS.md` -- remove or rewrite the stale claim that bare `review`
  is deprecated and forwards to `review-plan`.
- `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` -- remove bare `review` from its CLI
  forms list and delete the retained-alias claim.
- Read-only, no edit expected: `docs/exit-codes.md` (verify it still has
  no bare-`review` row/prose -- it already doesn't).
- Read-only historical records: `docs/adr/0005-snapshot-cache-architecture.md`,
  `docs/release-notes.md`, and `docs/output-schemas.md` retain accurate
  past/removal references.
- Read-only verification: `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py` establishes the
  live command set.

## Testing

Run the existing documentation checks. Confirm the registry has no bare
`review` route. Run `rg -n 'rebar review($|[^-])' AGENTS.md README.md
docs`, then classify every residual hit: the only allowed historical hits
are the ADR mapping row and the release-notes/output-schemas
removed-surface records; any operational-guidance hit is a failure.
Search the two edited operational pages for deprecated-forwarding and
retained-alias wording.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `AGENTS.md` contains no claim that bare `review` is deprecated and
      forwards to `review-plan`. Verified: grep for "forwards to...review-plan" is empty.
- [x] `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md` does not list bare `review` as a CLI
      form or retained alias. Verified: grep for "retained as an alias" is empty.
- [x] `docs/exit-codes.md` is confirmed (not edited) to contain no row or
      prose presenting bare `review` as an available or forwarding CLI
      command. Verified: file untouched by this change; confirmed no stale row exists.
- [x] The documented `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review`
      exit-code rows remain accurate and present in `docs/exit-codes.md`. Verified: unchanged, still present.
- [x] The anchored guidance search has no operational-guidance
      `rebar review` hit; only the explicitly enumerated ADR/removal-history
      records may remain. Verified via new test suite tests/unit/test_no_stale_bare_review_cli.py.
- [x] Existing documentation checks pass without expanding
      command-reference generation ownership. Verified: tests/unit/test_no_stale_bare_review_cli.py (9 tests) -- all pass. Committed 3dfd581e738a, pushed as Gerrit change 2543.
